classification: Existing library/current binding consumer research, not new creature credit or production.

provenance.version_boundary: Prior audit identifies4.8.4; no full source-binary equivalence proof and no dependency update. GeoBone from separate prior source cache is separately hashed, not silently assigned the same upstream pin.

alpha_chain: GeoRenderer.defaultRender gets global render color and passes alpha through actual rendering. Recursive draw passes alpha to cubes, quad vertex submission and child recursion. GeoEntityRenderer override follows the same alpha argument chain.

A per-bone override can supply alpha for its subtree through existing renderRecursively signature; setting getRenderColor alone affects the entire entity. Current TemplateMobRenderer per-bone override changes light/tint for other kinds, passes alpha unchanged. GHOST global alpha is phased.18 or normal.65; no ghostflame-specific death fade consumer present in inspected methods.

isHidden blocks own cubes; isHidingChildren independently blocks child recursion. Hiding eye cubes alone does not detach children or remove their transform. This matters for not accidentally suppressing both ghostflames.
transform_chain: GeoEntityRenderer pushes pose, applies local translation/pivot/rotation/scale, optionally records matrices, then translates away from pivot, draws cubes and recurses before pop. Child pose therefore inherits all parent transforms.

RenderUtils translation uses -X/16,Y/16,Z/16; bone rotations apply Z then Y then X; scale applies before translating away from pivot. A child local rise is transformed by parent scale/rotation; it is not a world-up trajectory.

Current ghostflames are children of ghost_eyes under helmet. Death clip2.2seconds scales ghost_eyes from1 at.9s to.05 at2.2s, rotates helmet20deg and pelvis35deg plus translation. No independent flame birth/rise/alpha channels. Merely adding local flameY would inherit eye shrink and collapse rotation.

Tracking matrix getter sets flag and returns stored matrix; setter overwrites stored matrix. The inspected getter is not a synchronous pose evaluation. Renderer updates only during tracking render traversal. A first/offscreen/late observer cannot be assumed to possess a current death-start matrix.

World matrix recorded at pivot before translate-away step: it is not automatically the full cube vertex transform. A detach consumer must account for pivot-away and any cube pivot/rotation, copy mutable matrix values per instance, and avoid applying entity transform twice.
proposal_only: Separate retained armor body and ghostflame draw transforms without altering accepted geometry/UV. Preserve44tick server death epoch; derive phase for late observers rather than replay from first render.

Original-pose transfer and contact/rest layout still need a verified producer/consumer chain; no implementation claimed. If render-only separation is later authorized after reference gate, do not create attack entities or duplicate authored cubes.
Keep weapon/accessory mesh ownership with texture specialist; body attachment interface only. Per-bone alpha delivery source proof does not replace shader/blend/native visual acceptance.
dedup: Reuses prior Bixi/library source evidence for a different applicability review, does not increment whole-creature count. Earlier Naga/Hydra/Magnetron/spirit/debris judgments remain intact.
